title: feat(docs): expose keyboard scrolling for wide reader content
summary: Wide reader content has a named keyboard-accessible scroll owner.
details: Find the actual overflowing code/table surface, including inner numbered-code overflow, and expose ordinary Arrow/Home/End scrolling without adding stops to fitting content.
Preserve source, line anchors, cells, selections and descendant controls; dispose annotations/observers with the document and exclude decorative permalink text from contextual labels.
